title: The gap in the digest
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wood drew a strip about the letter and pulled it. The week's digest has four dailies and a gap. The owner counts pages and asks about the fifth. Wood says there wasn't one. She says the staple says there was.

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner counting the digest's pages with a thumb. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner thumbing through a small stapled booklet counting pages while a young man and a dog wait, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The digest open at the middle: a blank page where a strip would be. The staple's holes with nothing to hold.

image.prompt: close on a small stapled booklet open to a blank page where a strip should be, black and white, no words
a laundromat owner looking up from a booklet, level, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood at the door. The pulled strip in his coat pocket, folded with the misfold and the note. The pocket is getting full of things the strip didn't run.

image.prompt: a young man leaving a laundromat with a hand pressed against a bulging coat pocket, a small dog at his heel, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The pulled strip. The pocket of things the strip didn't run.
